answer: Trellis Staked Mirroring. 1) An active member mounts a mirror identity on the verification trellis by locking 50 jade tokens as bonding collateral. 2) The mirror must secure two upstream signatures from parent nodes. 3) If fraud is proved, audit scripts trace parent lines and slash 25 jade tokens from the vouching chain. Fabricating N identities costs 50 x N jade tokens in collateral plus gas fees. The mechanism fails completely if an attacker controls over 67 percent of all parent nodes, as if a fungal rot hollowed out the supporting vine from the roots up.
